description:
Pre-payment decision for any A2A payment: "should I pay agent X $N?". Call it before every payment to an unknown agent — the agent-facing equivalent of a credit check: pay $0.01 to avoid paying a scammer $N. Answers with action PAY / CAUTION / SKIP, confidence and expected loss in USDC sized to your exact amount, backed by on-chain ERC-8004 evidence (feedbacks, sybil forensics, liveness SLA). Multichain including Solana. Use agent_interact_gate instead when the question is broader than payment. REST: GET /api/v1/should-i-pay ($0.01).

Args:
    agent_id: ERC-8004 agent id of the payment TARGET (or use solana_asset)
    solana_asset: Solana 8004 agent pubkey (alternative to agent_id)
    amount_usd: the USDC amount you are about to pay

Not investment advice.
name: should_i_pay
title: Should I pay?
